newsitem.title: CROATIA: Police seize record cocaine cargo in Croatian port.
newsitem.headline: Police seize record cocaine cargo in Croatian port.

text.p: Police and customs in the Adriatic port of Rijeka seized 375 kg (825 pounds) of cocaine on Tuesday in Croatia's largest drug haul, the state news agency HINA reported.
The find brought the quantity of cocaine discovered in the port to 561 kg in two months, the agency said.

The cocaine, worth over 130 million kuna ($37m), was hidden in a container aboard a ship from Ecuador and was destined for western Europe according to Ivan Nadj, head of the criminal police department at the Interior Ministry.
